sources.note: Exactly 4 entries coded [bsj]: Blench n.d. [1999] Atlas of Nigerian Languages (overview); Kleinewillinghöfer 1996 'Die nordwestlichen Adamawa-Sprachen' (overview;comparative;minimal); Kleinewillinghöfer 2014 'Tula-Waja group' (overview;comparative;wordlist); Adelberger 2024 (ethnographic). Name search adds only Adelberger 1994 (overview) and Wente-Lukas 1985 handbook. No phonology, grammar or grammar sketch entry exists for bsj. Descriptive works in the group exist only for Waja (Kleinewillinghöfer 1991) and Tula (Lukas 1955/56; Blench 2020).
